- [ ] I, the PR author, have personally reviewed every line of this PR.

# What does this PR do?

Replaces dev's own implementations of the layer-wise distributed optimizer (Muon), its sibling `DistributedOptimizer` and Muon's QKV handling with the converged code of the companion main PR (https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/pull/8919), keeping dev-only features. If both PRs merge, main and dev carry one implementation of this area; the remaining dev-only part is chunked optimizer-state offload.

Production code: +1467 / −1810 across 24 files (tests: +1548 / −1397).

## Changes

| Commit | Change |
| --- | --- |
| Optimizer: converge the LayerWise / DistOpt / Muon area with main | The LayerWise layout strategy (`--layer-wise-param-layout {padded,compact}`), the compact layout with an expert-DP sibling `DistributedOptimizer`, whole-param FP8 gathers (BF16 staged from the FP32 masters, requantized on every rank), QKV layout metadata with opt-in per-head and MLA splits, the checkpoint fixes, the device-side grad-norm combination, Q(bf16(master)) FP8 copies, QK-clip for HybridModel/MTP and buffers without CPU backup. Replaces `decouple_ddp_layout`, `merge_layerwise_fp8_grads` and dev's split-QKV variants. Chunked optimizer-state offload is rewired onto the converged layout API, and its DistOpt param-buffer staging now resets only its own bucket groups. |
| LayerWise: drop the legacy layout and the boolean layout flags | Removes `--no-use-layer-wise-param-layout` and `--use-layer-wise-param-layout`; `--layer-wise-param-layout` is the only switch. |
| DDP: partition bucket groups by owner and DDP config | With the compact layout and `reduce_scatter_with_fp32_accumulation`, LayerWise and DistOpt buckets could get each other's collectives; buffers are now partitioned by optimizer ownership and DDP config first. |
| Optimizer: build the layer-wise optimizer for fully frozen stages | A pipeline stage whose params are all frozen is no longer rejected. |
| LayerWise: reject FP8 params the padded layout cannot publish | dev's `validate_args` guard (padded FP8 param gather only for MXFP8 with the reused grad buffer) now lives in the shared LayerWise code. |

## Behavior changes for dev users

- The default layout becomes `padded`, as on main. Pass `--layer-wise-param-layout compact` to keep the previous default.
- `--no-use-layer-wise-param-layout` and `--use-layer-wise-param-layout` are removed and fail to parse.
- The TP > num_query_groups split and the GTP blockwise/distributed split variants follow main (skip / whole-matrix fallback).
- `merge_layerwise_fp8_grads` is removed, so FP8 and BF16 Muon gradients no longer share buckets.
- The compact layout no longer requires `--reuse-grad-buf-for-mxfp8-param-ag` for MXFP8.
- `--ckpt-format torch` is rejected for the layer-wise optimizer. It did not save the sibling `DistributedOptimizer` state.
- Fixed: with chunked offload, compact + MXFP8 + `--reuse-grad-buf-for-mxfp8-param-ag` + overlap diverged from the third step, because the DistOpt staging made already-published LayerWise groups gather again from offloaded masters.

Kept dev-only: Megatron-FSDP options, the FSDP model-to-main no-op, ungated FP8 shard quantization, the `--offload-optimizer-states` alias, nonuniform TP, frozen expert bias, DSv4 / head-wise gate annotations, chunked optimizer-state offload.

## Testing

- 8×H100 and 8×B300 under `--deterministic-mode`, comparing loss and grad norm at every step:
  - with `--layer-wise-param-layout compact`, dense, MoE and B300 MXFP8 with overlap are bitwise identical to dev;
  - offload on and off are bitwise identical (Adam, Muon compact, overlap, MoE, three offload managers, B300 MXFP8), including `torch_dist` resume;
  - the dev and main PRs are bitwise identical on their shared configurations;
  - `torch_dist` checkpoints written by dev (compact and padded) resume bitwise.
- Unit tests: the converged suites plus dev's offload, decoupled-FP8 and argument tests, updated for the removed layout and flags.
- Functional tests: `gpt3_moe_mcore_te_ep8_resume_torch_dist_dist_muon` and its `_1node` variant pin `--layer-wise-param-layout compact`, the layout they already ran with, so their golden values stay valid under the new padded default.

## Issue tracking

Linked issue: N/A

## Code provenance

No code was copied from other repositories. The converged code comes from the companion main PR in this repository.

## Contribution process

### Pre-checks

- [x] I have added relevant unit tests
- [ ] I have added relevant functional tests (existing configs updated)
- [x] If this PR adds or changes a GPU kernel (Triton, `jit_fuser`/`torch.compile`, CUDA extension, TE or external-library dispatch, or a scatter/index accumulation), I have added or updated its bit-exact determinism test and registered it in `tests/unit_tests/determinism/kernels/manifest.py`
- [x] I have added proper typing to my code
- [x] I have added relevant documentation
- [x] I have run the autoformatter on my PR (black, isort, pylint, ruff on the changed files)

@@ -59,3 +59,26 @@ The following figures show the sharding scheme and the main steps of the paramet
 - Call all-gather on each DP rank.
 - The parameter buffer now contains all 16 updated `bf16` model parameter elements. Parameters in PyTorch modules already point to the correct views in this buffer, so forward passes can start after the all-gather completes.
 - At this point, you can zero the gradient buffer for the next iteration.
+
+## Layer-Wise Distributed Optimizer
+
+Matrix optimizers such as Muon need each weight matrix whole. With `--optimizer muon --use-distributed-optimizer`, Megatron uses the layer-wise distributed optimizer: one data-parallel rank updates each Muon-managed matrix and then all-gathers it to the other ranks. A regular distributed optimizer next to it shards the remaining parameters (embeddings, output layer, biases, norms) as described above.
+
+`--layer-wise-param-layout` selects how the Muon-managed matrices are laid out across data-parallel ranks:
+
+| Layout | Gradient reduction | Parameter gather | Buffers |
+| ------ | ------ | ------ | ------ |
+| `padded` (default) | reduce-scatter | fixed-size all-gather from the parameter buffer | Each matrix lies whole inside one rank's shard; shards are padded to equal size. |
+| `compact` | all-reduce | all-gather of whole matrices with uneven sizes | No padding; every rank chooses the same owner rank for each matrix. |
+
+Both layouts store the same optimizer state, so a `torch_dist` checkpoint saved with one layout loads with the other. The layer-wise optimizer supports `--ckpt-format torch_dist` only.
+
+With `--fp8-param-gather`, the padded layout gathers the FP8 bytes of each shard and supports MXFP8 only together with `--reuse-grad-buf-for-mxfp8-param-ag`, which stages BF16 values and requantizes them on every rank. Use the compact layout for blockwise FP8 parameters; it gathers BF16 values and requantizes them on every rank.
+
+### Checkpoints of the removed legacy layout
+
+The legacy layout, selected with `--no-use-layer-wise-param-layout`, was removed together with the boolean `--use-layer-wise-param-layout` / `--no-use-layer-wise-param-layout` flags. It was also the only layout before the layer-wise optimizer gained its sibling distributed optimizer in May 2026. It kept the Adam-managed parameters inside the layer-wise optimizer, so its checkpoints store their optimizer state in a format that the current layouts do not read. Loading the optimizer state of such a checkpoint fails with a `KeyError` naming a `chained_*.optimizer.distributed.*` key.
+
+- To start a new run from such a checkpoint, such as fine-tuning, load only the model weights with `--no-load-optim`. The optimizer state starts fresh.
+- To resume an interrupted run, keep using the Megatron-LM version that wrote the checkpoint.
+- To carry the optimizer state over, convert the checkpoint yourself: the Muon state uses the same keys in every layout, and only the state of the Adam-managed parameters differs. Otherwise, open an issue describing the use case.

+    """Logical row layout of a packed attention projection weight.
+
+    Attention layers attach it to their packed weights as ``weight.qkv_layout`` so that
+    optimizers splitting such weights (Muon's split-QKV Newton-Schulz) need not infer the

+      projection split orthogonalizes each projection across all groups as one matrix.
+    - ``per_head_split_shapes``: one entry per head of each projection. Muon's per-head split
+      orthogonalizes every head of every group on its own.

+    A fused QKV weight has one group per query group. An MLA up-projection has one group per
+    attention head (``is_mla=True``) and splits into its per-head components, e.g. the
+    content and rotary parts of the query.

+        projection_split_shapes: Rows of each projection within one group.

+                f"{self.per_head_split_shapes} must cover the same rows of a group."

+        heads_per_group = config.num_attention_heads // config.num_query_groups
+        projection_split_shapes = [heads_per_group * config.kv_channels]
+        per_head_split_shapes = [config.kv_channels] * heads_per_group
+        if getattr(config, 'attention_output_gate', False):
+            projection_split_shapes.append(heads_per_group * config.kv_channels)
+            per_head_split_shapes += [config.kv_channels] * heads_per_group
+        projection_split_shapes += [config.kv_channels, config.kv_channels]
+        per_head_split_shapes += [config.kv_channels, config.kv_channels]

+            per_head_split_shapes=tuple(per_head_split_shapes),

+    from megatron.core.fp8_utils import requantize_whole_params_from_high_precision

+    from megatron.training.utils import get_device_arch_version
+
+    try:
+        import transformer_engine_torch as tex
+        from transformer_engine.pytorch.tensor.float8_blockwise_tensor import Float8BlockQuantizer
+        from transformer_engine.pytorch.tensor.mxfp8_tensor import MXFP8Quantizer
+    except ImportError:
+        pytest.skip("requires Transformer Engine quantized tensors")
+    arch = get_device_arch_version()
+    if recipe == "blockwise" and arch != 9:
+        pytest.skip("blockwise FP8 params are supported on Hopper")
+    if recipe == "mxfp8" and arch < 10:
+        pytest.skip("MXFP8 params need Blackwell")
+    seeded()
+    quantizer_cls = Float8BlockQuantizer if recipe == "blockwise" else MXFP8Quantizer
+    shapes = [(1024, 512), (384, 1024), (2048, 256)]
+    masters = tuple(torch.randn(*shape, device="cuda") for shape in shapes)
+
+    def fp8_param(shape):
+        quantizer = quantizer_cls(tex.DType.kFloat8E4M3, rowwise=True, columnwise=True)
+        empty = quantizer.make_empty(shape, dtype=torch.bfloat16, device="cuda")
+        return torch.nn.Parameter(empty, requires_grad=False)
+
+    def fp8_data(param):
+        names = ("_rowwise_data", "_rowwise_scale_inv", "_columnwise_data", "_columnwise_scale_inv")
+        return [getattr(param.data, n) for n in names if getattr(param.data, n, None) is not None]
+
+    def copy(quantized_master, gathered_master, plain_master):
+        quantized, gathered = fp8_param(quantized_master.shape), fp8_param(gathered_master.shape)
+        # The whole-param gather publishes this one; the copy leaves it alone.
+        gathered.requantized_by_layer_wise_gather = True
+        plain = torch.nn.Parameter(torch.empty_like(plain_master, dtype=torch.bfloat16))
+        optimizer = Float16OptimizerWithFloat16Params.__new__(Float16OptimizerWithFloat16Params)
+        optimizer.float16_groups = [[quantized, gathered, plain]]
+        optimizer.fp32_from_float16_groups = [[quantized_master, gathered_master, plain_master]]
+        optimizer._dummy_overflow_buf = torch.zeros(1, dtype=torch.int, device="cuda")
+        optimizer._copy_main_params_to_model_params_via_bf16()
+        return fp8_data(quantized) + [plain.data]
+
+    got = copy(*masters)
+    reference = fp8_param(shapes[0])
+    requantize_whole_params_from_high_precision([reference], [masters[0].to(torch.bfloat16)])
+    for a, b in zip(got, fp8_data(reference) + [masters[2].to(torch.bfloat16)]):
+        assert bytes_equal(a, b), "the copy must write Q(bf16(master))"
+    assert_replays_bit_exact(
+        copy, masters, replays=4, backward=False, contention=True, what=f"{recipe} master copy"
+    )

+    elif isinstance(sharded_state_dict, list):

+    else:
+        return

+"""CPU tests for how the layer-wise distributed optimizer plan is resolved.
+
+Covers the LayerWise data-parallel layout (padded, compact), the optimizer intent, the DDP
+wrapping decision and the rank-independent whole-parameter owners of the compact layout.
+"""
+
+import random
+from contextlib import nullcontext
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+from unittest import mock
+
+import pytest
+import torch
+
+from megatron.core.distributed.distributed_data_parallel_config import (
+    DistributedDataParallelConfig,
+    resolve_layer_wise_param_layout,
+)
+from megatron.core.optimizer.layer_wise_optimizer import (
+    LayerWiseDistributedOptimizer,
+    configure_ddp_for_layer_wise_optimizer,
+)
+from megatron.core.optimizer.optimizer_config import resolve_layer_wise_distributed_optimizer
+
+
+def _param(shape, **attrs):
+    param = torch.nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(shape, dtype=torch.bfloat16))
+    for name, value in attrs.items():
+        setattr(param, name, value)
+    return param
+
+
+def _model():
+    """Muon matrices, an embedding, a bias and an excluded matrix."""
+    model = torch.nn.Module()
+    model.embedding = _param((32, 8), is_embedding_or_output_parameter=True)
+    model.fc1 = _param((16, 8))
+    model.fc1_bias = _param((16,))
+    model.fc2 = _param((8, 16))
+    model.router = _param((4, 8), use_muon=False)
+    return model
+
+
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+# Layout and optimizer-intent resolution.
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    ("layout", "expected"), [(None, "padded"), ("padded", "padded"), ("compact", "compact")]
+)
+def test_resolve_layer_wise_param_layout(layout, expected):
+    assert resolve_layer_wise_param_layout(layout) == expected
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("layout", ["legacy", "ragged"])
+def test_resolve_layer_wise_param_layout_rejects_unknown_layouts(layout):
+    # The legacy layout was removed; naming it is an error, not a silent fallback.
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
+        resolve_layer_wise_param_layout(layout)
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
+        DistributedDataParallelConfig(layer_wise_param_layout=layout)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    ("optimizer", "use_distopt", "use_layer_wise", "expected"),
+    [
+        ("adam", False, False, ("adam", False)),
+        ("adam", True, False, ("adam", False)),
+        ("sgd", True, False, ("sgd", False)),
+        ("muon", False, False, ("muon", False)),
+        ("muon", True, False, ("muon", True)),
+        ("muon", False, True, ("muon", True)),
+        ("dist_muon", False, False, ("muon", True)),
+        ("lion", True, False, ("lion", True)),
+        ("adaptive_muon", True, False, ("adaptive_muon", True)),
+    ],
+)
+def test_resolve_layer_wise_distributed_optimizer(optimizer, use_distopt, use_layer_wise, expected):
+    assert (
+        resolve_layer_wise_distributed_optimizer(optimizer, use_distopt, use_layer_wise) == expected
+    )
+
+
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+# DDP wrapping decision shared by get_model() and the ModelBuilder path.
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("layout", [None, "padded", "compact"])
+def test_configure_ddp_for_sharded_layer_wise_layouts(layout):
+    model = _model()
+    # The container clears use_distributed_optimizer for the layer-wise optimizer.
+    ddp_config = DistributedDataParallelConfig(layer_wise_param_layout=layout)
+    fn = configure_ddp_for_layer_wise_optimizer(
+        [model], ddp_config, use_layer_wise_distributed_optimizer=True
+    )
+    assert fn == LayerWiseDistributedOptimizer.compute_full_param_layout
+    assert ddp_config.use_distributed_optimizer
+    assert ddp_config.layer_wise_param_layout == (layout or "padded")
+    assert model.fc1.is_managed_by_layer_wise_optimizer
+    assert model.fc2.is_managed_by_layer_wise_optimizer
+    for name in ("embedding", "fc1_bias", "router"):
+        assert not getattr(model, name).is_managed_by_layer_wise_optimizer
+
+    # Resolving again (e.g. a second wrap of the same config) is stable.
+    assert (
+        configure_ddp_for_layer_wise_optimizer(
+            [model], ddp_config, use_layer_wise_distributed_optimizer=True
+        )
+        == fn
+    )
+    assert ddp_config.layer_wise_param_layout == (layout or "padded")
+
+
+def test_layer_wise_rejects_chunks_without_a_layer_wise_layout():
+    # Chunks wrapped without a LayerWise layout (the removed legacy layout) are rejected.
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="padded or compact"):
+        LayerWiseDistributedOptimizer._resolve_param_layout(
+            DistributedDataParallelConfig(use_distributed_optimizer=False), None
+        )
+    # Direct construction without DDP-wrapped chunks owns and gathers whole params.
+    assert LayerWiseDistributedOptimizer._resolve_param_layout(None, None) == "compact"
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    ("kind", "reuse_grad_buf", "allowed"),
+    [
+        ("bf16", False, True),
+        ("mxfp8", True, True),
+        ("mxfp8", False, False),
+        ("blockwise", True, False),
+    ],
+)
+def test_padded_layout_rejects_quantized_params_it_cannot_publish(kind, reuse_grad_buf, allowed):
+    # The padded gather moves raw bytes; only MXFP8 staged through the grad buffer is
+    # requantized on every rank, so other FP8 params would keep stale scales off-owner.
+    optimizer = SimpleNamespace(param_groups=[{"params": [_param((8, 8))]}])
+    module = "megatron.core.optimizer.layer_wise_optimizer"
+    with (
+        mock.patch(f"{module}._param_uses_quantized_storage", return_value=kind != "bf16"),
+        mock.patch(f"{module}.is_mxfp8tensor", return_value=kind == "mxfp8"),
+        nullcontext() if allowed else pytest.raises(ValueError, match="compact"),
+    ):
+        LayerWiseDistributedOptimizer._check_padded_param_gather_storage(
+            [optimizer], SimpleNamespace(reuse_grad_buf_for_mxfp8_param_ag=reuse_grad_buf)
+        )
+
+
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+# Rank-independent whole-parameter owners of the compact layout.
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+
+def _ddp_chunk(params):
+    """Exposes the DDP buffer metadata ``_build_param_sort_keys`` reads."""
+    index_map, start = {}, 0
+    for param in reversed(params):
+        index_map[param] = (start, start + param.numel(), 0)
+        start += param.numel()
+    return SimpleNamespace(
+        buffers=[SimpleNamespace(param_index_map=index_map)], expert_parallel_buffers=[]
+    )
+
+
+def _owners(params_in_group_order, sort_keys, dp_size, rank):
+    """Run the ping-pong assignment for ``rank`` with mocked process groups."""
+    groups = [{"params": [p], "is_expert_parallel": False} for p in params_in_group_order]
+    optimizer = SimpleNamespace(param_groups=groups)
+    lwo = LayerWiseDistributedOptimizer.__new__(LayerWiseDistributedOptimizer)
+    lwo.dp_cp = "dp_cp"
+    lwo.expt_dp = "expt_dp"
+    with (
+        mock.patch("megatron.core.optimizer.layer_wise_optimizer.get_pg_rank", return_value=rank),
+        mock.patch(
+            "megatron.core.optimizer.layer_wise_optimizer.get_pg_size", return_value=dp_size
+        ),
+    ):
+        lwo.shard_params([optimizer], param_sort_keys=sort_keys)
+    local = [p for group in groups for p in group["params"]]
+    return lwo.dp_cp_params_list, local
+
+
+def test_compact_owners_do_not_depend_on_param_group_order():
+    # Equal-numel params are where a numel-only stable sort could disagree across ranks.
+    params = [_param((8, 8)) for _ in range(6)] + [_param((4, 8)) for _ in range(3)]
+    sort_keys = LayerWiseDistributedOptimizer._build_param_sort_keys([_ddp_chunk(params)])
+    assert set(sort_keys) == set(params)
+
+    reference, _ = _owners(params, sort_keys, dp_size=4, rank=0)
+    rng = random.Random(1234)
+    for rank in range(4):
+        shuffled = list(params)
+        rng.shuffle(shuffled)
+        owner_lists, local = _owners(shuffled, sort_keys, dp_size=4, rank=rank)
+        assert owner_lists == reference
+        assert set(local) == set(reference[rank])
+    # Every param has exactly one owner.
+    assert sorted(id(p) for owned in reference for p in owned) == sorted(id(p) for p in params)

+"""Multi-GPU tests of the compact LayerWise layout next to the padded layout.
+
+The compact layout keeps Muon-managed matrices in unpadded, replicated DDP buffers (gradient
+all-reduce, one owner rank per matrix, uneven parameter all-gather) while a sibling
+DistributedOptimizer shards the remaining parameters. Each test trains a small model for a few
+steps with real NCCL collectives and checks the DDP structure, rank-consistent ownership and the
+updates against a non-distributed Muon reference.
+"""

+import os

+class _DenseAndExpertModel(nn.Module):
+    """Dense and expert matrices (Muon) with biases (Adam) and an excluded matrix (Adam)."""
+
+    def __init__(self, with_experts=False, hidden=64):
+        super().__init__()
+        self.fc1 = nn.Linear(32, hidden)
+        self.fc2 = nn.Linear(hidden, hidden)
+        self.fc3 = nn.Linear(hidden, 48)
+        self.gate = nn.Linear(48, 48, bias=False)
+        self.gate.weight.use_muon = False
+        self.out = nn.Linear(48, 16)
+        self.with_experts = with_experts
+        if with_experts:
+            # Named "experts" so the Muon factory tags them for the expert TP group.
+            self.experts = nn.ModuleList([nn.Linear(48, 48) for _ in range(3)])
+            for param in self.experts.parameters():
+                param.allreduce = False
+
+    def forward(self, x):
+        x = F.relu(self.fc1(x))
+        x = F.relu(self.fc2(x))
+        x = F.relu(self.fc3(x))
+        x = x + torch.tanh(self.gate(x))
+        if self.with_experts:
+            for expert in self.experts:
+                x = x + 0.5 * torch.tanh(expert(x))
+        return self.out(x)
+
+
+def _layer_wise(optimizer):
+    if isinstance(optimizer, LayerWiseDistributedOptimizer):
+        return optimizer
+    for sub_optimizer in getattr(optimizer, 'chained_optimizers', [optimizer]):
+        if isinstance(sub_optimizer, LayerWiseDistributedOptimizer):
+            return sub_optimizer
+    raise AssertionError("No LayerWiseDistributedOptimizer in the optimizer chain")
+
+
+def _distopts(optimizer):
+    return [
+        sub_optimizer
+        for sub_optimizer in getattr(optimizer, 'chained_optimizers', [optimizer])
+        if isinstance(sub_optimizer, DistributedOptimizer)
+    ]
+

+def _build(
+    layout,
+    *,
+    with_experts=False,
+    overlap=False,
+    bucket_size=None,
+    grad_reduce_in_fp32=True,
+    seed=1234,
+    clip_grad=1.0,
+):
+    """Return (ddp_model, optimizer) for a LayerWise layout or the ``"reference"`` setup."""
+    from megatron.training.training import wrap_model_chunks_with_ddp
+
+    torch.manual_seed(seed)
+    model = _DenseAndExpertModel(with_experts=with_experts).bfloat16().cuda()
+    reference = layout == "reference"
+    ddp_config = DistributedDataParallelConfig(
+        overlap_grad_reduce=overlap,
+        overlap_param_gather=overlap and not reference,
+        grad_reduce_in_fp32=grad_reduce_in_fp32,
+        bucket_size=bucket_size,
+        layer_wise_param_layout=None if reference else layout,
+    )
+    model = wrap_model_chunks_with_ddp(
+        [model],
+        TransformerConfig(num_attention_heads=1, num_layers=1),
+        ddp_config,
+        use_layer_wise_distributed_optimizer=not reference,
+    )[0]
+    optimizer = get_megatron_optimizer(
+        OptimizerConfig(
+            optimizer='muon',
+            lr=0.02,
+            weight_decay=0.01,
+            bf16=True,
+            clip_grad=clip_grad,
+            muon_tp_mode='duplicated',
+            # Muon + distributed optimizer is the layer-wise distributed Muon.
+            use_distributed_optimizer=not reference,
+        ),
+        [model],
+        pg_collection=ProcessGroupCollection.use_mpu_process_groups(),
+        use_gloo_process_groups=False,
+    )
+    return model, optimizer
+
+
+def _train_step(model, optimizer, step):
+    """One step with per-DP-rank data; returns the grad norm after params are published."""
+    dp_rank = parallel_state.get_data_parallel_rank(with_context_parallel=True)
+    generator = torch.Generator(device='cuda').manual_seed(100 * step + dp_rank)
+    x = torch.randn(8, 32, generator=generator, device='cuda', dtype=torch.bfloat16)
+    model.zero_grad_buffer()
+    loss = model(x).float().pow(2).mean()
+    loss.backward()
+    model.finish_grad_sync()
+    success, grad_norm, _ = optimizer.step()
+    assert success
+    if model.ddp_config.overlap_param_gather:
+        # The next forward pre-hook would gather; publish now to compare parameters.
+        model.start_param_sync(force_sync=True)
+    return float(grad_norm)
+
+
+def _assert_replicas_equal(model):
+    """Every rank of a parameter's data-parallel group holds the same value."""
+    for name, param in model.module.named_parameters():
+        expert = not getattr(param, 'allreduce', True)
+        group = (
+            parallel_state.get_expert_data_parallel_group()
+            if expert
+            else parallel_state.get_data_parallel_group(with_context_parallel=True)
+        )
+        replicas = [torch.empty_like(param) for _ in range(get_pg_size(group))]
+        torch.distributed.all_gather(replicas, param.data.contiguous(), group=group)
+        for replica in replicas[1:]:
+            torch.testing.assert_close(replica, replicas[0], rtol=0, atol=0, msg=name)
+
+
+def _owner_names(model, layer_wise):
+    names = {param: name for name, param in model.module.named_parameters()}
+    owners = {}
+    for params_list in (layer_wise.dp_cp_params_list, layer_wise.expt_dp_params_list):
+        for rank, owned in enumerate(params_list or []):
+            for param in owned:
+                owners.setdefault(names[param], []).append(rank)
+    return owners
+

+class TestPendingGatherPublication:
+    """Every path that completes an in-flight variable-size LayerWise gather publishes it.
+
+    The forward pre-hook normally completes the gather (``finish_param_sync``). A forced
+    synchronous sync and ``free_overlap_buffers`` (before async checkpoint saves) complete it
+    too, and must copy the gathered params out of ``grad_data`` and clear it.
+    """
+
+    @pytest.fixture(autouse=True)
+    def model_parallel(self):
+        Utils.initialize_model_parallel()
+        yield
+        Utils.destroy_model_parallel()
+
+    @pytest.mark.parametrize("complete", ["force_sync", "free_overlap_buffers"])
+    def test_pending_gather_is_published(self, complete):
+        model, optimizer = _build("compact", overlap=True, bucket_size=4096)
+        owned = [p for params in _layer_wise(optimizer).dp_cp_params_list for p in params]
+        before = [p.detach().clone() for p in owned]
+
+        dp_rank = parallel_state.get_data_parallel_rank(with_context_parallel=True)
+        generator = torch.Generator(device='cuda').manual_seed(dp_rank)
+        x = torch.randn(8, 32, generator=generator, device='cuda', dtype=torch.bfloat16)
+        model.zero_grad_buffer()
+        model(x).float().pow(2).mean().backward()
+        model.finish_grad_sync()
+        assert optimizer.step()[0]
+        # Dispatch the gathers that the next forward pre-hooks would start, then complete
+        # them without a forward pass.
+        model.start_param_sync()
+        bucket_groups = model.bucket_groups + model.expert_parallel_bucket_groups
+        pending = [
+            bucket_group
+            for bucket_group in bucket_groups
+            if bucket_group.param_gather_handle is not None
+            and any(bucket.layerwise_gather_list is not None for bucket in bucket_group.buckets)
+        ]
+        assert pending, "Expected an in-flight variable-size LayerWise gather"
+        if complete == "force_sync":
+            model.start_param_sync(force_sync=True)
+        else:
+            model.free_overlap_buffers()
+
+        for bucket_group in bucket_groups:
+            assert bucket_group.param_gather_handle is None
+            assert all(bucket.layerwise_gather_list is None for bucket in bucket_group.buckets)
+        for bucket_group in pending:
+            for bucket in bucket_group.buckets:
+                # grad_data was the receive buffer; the next backward accumulates from zero.
+                assert torch.count_nonzero(bucket.grad_data) == 0
+        _assert_replicas_equal(model)
+        for param, old in zip(owned, before):
+            assert not torch.equal(param, old), "An owner's update was not published"
+
+        # Training continues normally from the published state.
+        _train_step(model, optimizer, step=1)
+        _assert_replicas_equal(model)
+
